description: Audit an existing project's design system from its CSS, Tailwind config, and HTML templates. Generates a DESIGN.md documenting what exists, a Tailwind v4 theme (or migration), and an accessibility report. Use when the user says "audit my design", "audit this project's design", "document my design system", "migrate to tailwind", "convert to tailwind", or similar.
